conduit.note: Maximum single-core V-90 (unsheathed) cables in round conduit – Olex Handbook 2013 p.95, straight runs / fittings at ends only, one earth may be added. Medium confidence (read via summariser). LD = light duty, HD = heavy duty (thicker wall, smaller bore). Flat TPS in conduit: no published count found.
conduit.space: Space factor (AS/NZS 3000 App C via Olex Handbook and elek – high confidence): 1 cable 50% of conduit area, 2 cables 33%, 3 or more 40%.

vd_limits: AS/NZS 3000: 5% total from point of supply (11.5 V at 230 V) – high confidence via Olex/Prysmian/elek. 7% with an on-premises substation; 11% for stand-alone systems (elek, single source, medium).
